name: Dolibarr
description: Dolibarr open-source ERP and CRM: third parties, contacts, customer and supplier invoices, orders, proposals, products and stock. REST API on your own installation, DOLAPIKEY auth.
instructions:
**Turn the module on first.** Dolibarr ships the REST API as a module that is off by default.
1. As an administrator go to **Setup → Modules → Web Services API REST** and enable it.
2. Open the user you want the agent to act as, go to the **User card → API key** area, and generate a key. Put it in `DOLIBARR_API_KEY`.
3. Set `DOLIBARR_URL` to your installation root (no trailing slash, no `/api`). The adapter appends `/api/index.php`.

**The header is `DOLAPIKEY`.** Not `Authorization`. Dolibarr also accepts it as a query parameter, but a header keeps it out of the access log.

**Permissions follow the user, per module.** Dolibarr's rights are fine-grained — a user with no *read invoices* permission gets a 403 on `/invoices`, and one with no *read third parties* sees an empty list. Grant exactly what the agent needs on a dedicated user.

**`sqlfilters` is the powerful part.** Dolibarr's list endpoints accept a filter expression like `(t.datec:>=:'2026-01-01') and (t.fk_statut:=:1)` — the colon-delimited operator syntax is Dolibarr's own and is documented on the wiki. Field names are the SQL column names, prefixed `t.`.

**Status codes are integers with per-object meanings.** An invoice's `status` 0 is draft, 1 validated, 2 paid, 3 abandoned. An order's are different again. Do not assume they line up.

**Self-hosted, which is the thing to plan for.**
- On **AnythingMCP Cloud** the instance must be reachable from the public internet on a real hostname with a valid TLS certificate. A self-signed certificate will fail: the connector offers no trust-anything switch.
- On an internal host (`erp.intern`, `10.0.0.x`), self-host AnythingMCP on the same network and add that host to `SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTS`, or the outbound guard refuses the call before it is made.

tools.name: dolibarr_get_status
tools.description: Read the Dolibarr version and API status of this installation. No permission needed — the fastest proof that the module is on and the key is accepted.

tools.name: dolibarr_list_thirdparties
tools.description: List third parties — Dolibarr's customers, suppliers and prospects — with their name, VAT number, address and customer/supplier flags.

sortfield.description: SQL field to sort by, e.g. t.nom.

mode.description: 1 for customers only, 2 for prospects, 3 for neither, 4 for suppliers.

tools.name: dolibarr_get_thirdparty
tools.description: Read one third party in full: addresses, tax identifiers, payment terms, assigned sales representative and account balances.

tools.name: dolibarr_list_invoices
tools.description: List customer invoices with their reference, date, third party, totals and status. Status 0 is draft, 1 validated, 2 paid, 3 abandoned.

sortfield.description: SQL field to sort by, e.g. t.datef.

thirdparty_ids.description: Comma-separated third-party ids to restrict to.

status.description: Status filter: draft, unpaid, paid or cancelled.

tools.name: dolibarr_get_invoice
tools.description: Read one customer invoice in full: every line with quantity, unit price, discount and VAT, the totals, and the payments applied against it.

tools.name: dolibarr_list_orders
tools.description: List customer orders with their reference, date, third party, total and status, for the pipeline between proposal and invoice.

tools.name: dolibarr_list_proposals
tools.description: List commercial proposals (devis) with their reference, date, third party, total and whether they have been signed.

tools.name: dolibarr_list_supplier_invoices
tools.description: List supplier invoices with their reference, date, supplier, total and payment status — the payables side of the ledger.

tools.name: dolibarr_list_products
tools.description: List products and services with their reference, label, sale and cost price, VAT rate and stock quantity.

mode.description: 0 for all, 1 for products only, 2 for services only.

tools.name: dolibarr_get_product_stock
tools.description: Read the per-warehouse stock of one product — the answer an availability question actually needs, rather than the cached total on the product record.
